title: Simon Marrero teaches him to bow and repair bass
summary: Simon Marrero taught him to read and bow, and he practically lived at Marrero's house. He started in his teens.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Bass players: lineage, tone and technique

blocks.x: Jimmy Johnson, yes. Mr. Johnson. I always called him Mr. Johnson. As a bass player. Yes, he was another one. He played up now mostly. Yeah. He was a fine bass player too. Yes, he did. All those men used to read very good. They were good readers. Like old man Kimball and Jimmy. And this fellow, I'm telling you, was my brother then. And then Simon, later on when I got with Simon, he was the first one who started me to read him. Showed me how to bow bass. And I'll never forget. And he was always right. He says, Al, that's what I'm showing you. Always remember to learn the bow. That's what these things are for.
Like you do last time. He says, bow.

Yes. He says, always learn the bow of the bass. And I started with him. And I used to practically live at his house. And I learned a lot from him. He used to repair his own bass and take them down. And I learned everything about a bass, fooling with him. When I was in the teaching.
How old were you when you first started this?
Oh, I was in my teens.
You could reach him all right.
Yeah, yeah. Oh, yes. I could reach.
